import.debitsOk: Debit total matches the statement ({amount} Kč) ✓
import.debitsBad: Debit total does NOT match the statement: printed {printed}, parsed {parsed}

notice.demo: Demo with fake sample data. Nothing you import here is saved. Download the dashboard to use it with your own statements.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacy: Everything on this page stays in this browser. Statements are read locally and nothing is uploaded anywhere.
settings.ownHelp: One per line, optionally with a label, e.g. "FIO main: 2900000001/2010". Money moved between these is not spending.
settings.investHelp: Brokers, bond issuers, savings products. Payments to them count as investments, shown only when "Include investments" is on.
settings.catAcctHelp: One category per line: "Housing & utilities: 4000000001/0100, 4000000002/0800". Wins over keywords. Categories: {categories}.
settings.fxHelp: One per line, e.g. "EUR = 25". Foreign amounts are converted at these fixed rates.
settings.rulesHelp: Keywords per category, accounts and rates in one JSON file. Export it as a backup or to edit the keywords, import it on another computer.
settings.resetConfirm: Replace your rules with the defaults? Your accounts and rates are removed too.
settings.imported: Rules imported. All transactions were re-classified.
settings.dataHelp: Removes every imported transaction, your rules and your category choices from this browser. Theme and language stay.
settings.forgetConfirm: Remove all imported transactions, rules and category choices from this browser? This cannot be undone.
